reference_sql:
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- one row per like-for-like store
  SELECT store_id, store_code
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web'
    AND opened_on <= DATE '2023-09-01'
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date > DATE '2025-09-30')
),
september_sales AS (
  -- one row per store with sales in either September
  SELECT store_code,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2025
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
     OR order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY store_code
)
SELECT l.store_id, l.store_code,
       COALESCE(s.sales_2024, 0) AS sales_sep_2024_eur,
       COALESCE(s.sales_2025, 0) AS sales_sep_2025_eur,
       CASE WHEN s.sales_2024 > 0 AND s.sales_2025 > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (s.sales_2025 - s.sales_2024) / s.sales_2024, 1) END AS lfl_pct
FROM lfl_stores AS l
LEFT JOIN september_sales AS s ON s.store_code = l.store_code
ORDER BY l.store_id

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_sep_2024_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_sep_2025_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * (NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END), 0)
                      - SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END))
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS lfl_pct
FROM stores AS st
LEFT JOIN sales AS s
  ON s.store_code = st.store_code
 AND (s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
      OR s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30')
WHERE st.store_type <> 'web'
  AND st.opened_on <= DATE '2023-09-01'
  AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date > DATE '2025-09-30')
GROUP BY st.store_id, st.store_code
ORDER BY st.store_id

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- one row per like-for-like store
  SELECT store_id, store_code
  FROM stores
  WHERE store_type <> 'web'
    AND opened_on <= DATE '2023-09-01'
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date > DATE '2025-09-30')
),
sep_2024 AS (
  -- one row per store with order lines in September 2024
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS sales_eur
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
),
sep_2025 AS (
  -- one row per store with order lines in September 2025
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS sales_eur
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT l.store_id, l.store_code,
       COALESCE(a.sales_eur, 0) AS sales_sep_2024_eur,
       COALESCE(b.sales_eur, 0) AS sales_sep_2025_eur,
       CASE WHEN a.sales_eur > 0 AND b.sales_eur > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (b.sales_eur - a.sales_eur) / a.sales_eur, 1) END AS lfl_pct
FROM lfl_stores AS l
LEFT JOIN sep_2024 AS a ON a.store_id = l.store_id
LEFT JOIN sep_2025 AS b ON b.store_id = l.store_id
ORDER BY l.store_id

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_sep_2024_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS sales_sep_2025_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * (NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END), 0)
                      - SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END))
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN s.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS lfl_pct
FROM stores AS st
LEFT JOIN sales AS s
  ON s.store_code = st.store_code
 AND (s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
      OR s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30')
WHERE st.store_type <> 'web'
  AND st.opened_on <= DATE '2023-09-01'
  AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date > DATE '2025-09-30')
GROUP BY st.store_id, st.store_code
ORDER BY st.store_id
other_way.tradeoff: One grouped LEFT JOIN with the months in ON is shorter, but the month filter must stay in ON, not WHERE, to keep every store.

solver.query:
WITH st AS (SELECT store_id, store_code FROM stores WHERE store_type <> 'web' AND CAST(opened_on AS DATE) <= DATE '2023-09-01' AND (close_date IS NULL OR CAST(close_date AS DATE) > DATE '2025-09-30')),
s AS (SELECT o.store_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS s24,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS s25
 FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
 WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' OR CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.store_id),
r AS (SELECT st.store_id, st.store_code, COALESCE(s.s24, 0) AS sales_sep_2024_eur, COALESCE(s.s25, 0) AS sales_sep_2025_eur FROM st LEFT JOIN s ON s.store_id = st.store_id)
SELECT store_id, store_code, sales_sep_2024_eur, sales_sep_2025_eur,
 CASE WHEN sales_sep_2024_eur > 0 AND sales_sep_2025_eur > 0 THEN ROUND(100 * (sales_sep_2025_eur - sales_sep_2024_eur) / sales_sep_2024_eur, 1) END AS lfl_pct
FROM r ORDER BY store_id
